name: handoff
title: Enquiry handoff
for_each: select id,code from leads where status in ('assigned','accepted') order by code

sections.title: Recorded notes
sections.sql: select actor,body,created_at from notes where lead_id=$1 order by created_at

name: routing-decision
title: Assignment decision record
for_each: select id,code from leads where owner_id is not null order by code

sections.title: Decision
sections.sql: select l.code,r.name as owner,ru.name as rule,a.actor,a.reason,a.created_at from assignments a join leads l on l.id=a.lead_id join reps r on r.id=a.rep_id join rules ru on ru.id=a.rule_id where l.id=$1

sections.title: Events
sections.sql: select kind,actor,details,created_at from activity where record_id=$1 order by created_at
